eventos.texto: Good afternoon, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Línea reconocida: hay una ficha con ese teléfono
Hello, I'm calling for my son. He needs to see the pediatrician, the earliest you have.
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Falta el nombre para buscar la ficha

And who is the appointment for? Their full name and date of birth, please.
